PowerShell(try { $vfp = New-Object -ComObject VisualFoxPro.Application; $vfp.DoCmd\("USE 'C:\\4c\\Framework\\ClassResp.VCX' SHARED IN 0 ALIAS CrVcx"\); $vfp.DoCmd\("SET FILTER TO PARENT='clsconta.pgframeDados.pgFrameDados7.Gradei' OR PARENT='clsconta.pgframeDados.pgFrameDados7.Gradei.Column1' OR PARENT='clsconta.pgframeDados.pgFrameDados7.Gradei.Column3'"\); $vfp.DoCmd\("GO TOP"\); do { if \($vfp.Eval\("EOF\(\)"\) -eq $true\) { break }; Write-Output \("=" + $vfp.Eval\("PARENT"\) + " :: " + $vfp.Eval\("OBJNAME"\) + " \(class=" + $vfp.Eval\("CLASS"\) + "\)"\); $vfp.DoCmd\("SKIP"\) } while \($true\); $vfp.Quit\(\) } catch { Write-Output "Error: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(try { $vfp = New-Object -ComObject VisualFoxPro.Application; $vfp.DoCmd\("USE 'C:\\4c\\Framework\\ClassResp.VCX' SHARED IN 0 ALIAS CrVcx"\); $vfp.DoCmd\("GO TOP"\); $items = @\(\); do { if \($vfp.Eval\("EOF\(\)"\) -eq $true\) { break }; $parent = $vfp.Eval\("PARENT"\); if \($parent -imatch "gradei|gradec"\) { $items += "$parent :: $\($vfp.Eval\('OBJNAME'\)\) [class=$\($vfp.Eval\('CLASS'\)\)]" }; $vfp.DoCmd\("SKIP"\) } while \($true\); $items | Sort-Object -Unique | Select-Object -First 40; $vfp.Quit\(\) } catch { Write-Output "Error: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(try { $vfp = New-Object -ComObject VisualFoxPro.Application; foreach \($v in @\("framework.vcx","classresp.vcx","classobj.vcx","ClassOpPen.VCX","ClassScrl.vcx","ClassGdi.vcx"\)\) { $vfp.DoCmd\("USE 'C:\\4c\\Framework\\$v' SHARED IN 0 ALIAS _T"\); $vfp.DoCmd\("SELECT _T"\); $vfp.DoCmd\("LOCATE FOR UPPER\(ALLTRIM\(OBJNAME\)\)='FWCOMBO'"\); Write-Output "$v : found=$\($vfp.Eval\('FOUND\(\)'\)\)"; $vfp.DoCmd\("USE IN _T"\) }; $vfp.Quit\(\) } catch { Write-Output "Error: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(try { $vfp = New-Object -ComObject VisualFoxPro.Application; $vfp.DoCmd\("USE 'C:\\4c\\Framework\\ClassResp.VCX' SHARED IN 0 ALIAS CrVcx"\); $vfp.DoCmd\("LOCATE FOR PARENT='clsconta.pgframeDados.pgFrameDados7' AND UPPER\(ALLTRIM\(OBJNAME\)\)='GRADEI'"\); Write-Output \("Found=" + $vfp.Eval\("FOUND\(\)"\)\); if \($vfp.Eval\("FOUND\(\)"\) -eq $true\) { Write-Output "--PROPERTIES--"; Write-Output $vfp.Eval\("PROPERTIES"\) }; $vfp.DoCmd\("LOCATE FOR PARENT='clsconta.pgframeDados.pgFrameDados7.Gradei' AND UPPER\(ALLTRIM\(OBJNAME\)\)='COLUMN1'"\); Write-Output "--COLUMN1 Found=$\($vfp.Eval\('FOUND\(\)'\)\)"; if \($vfp.Eval\("FOUND\(\)"\)\) { Write-Output $vfp.Eval\("PROPERTIES"\) }; $vfp.Quit\(\) } catch { Write-Output "Error: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(try { $vfp = New-Object -ComObject VisualFoxPro.Application; $vfp.DoCmd\("USE 'C:\\4c\\Framework\\ClassResp.VCX' SHARED IN 0 ALIAS CrVcx"\); $vfp.DoCmd\("GO TOP"\); do { if \($vfp.Eval\("EOF\(\)"\) -eq $true\) { break }; $obj = $vfp.Eval\("OBJNAME"\); $parent = $vfp.Eval\("PARENT"\); if \($obj -imatch "gradei" -or \($parent -imatch "gradei" -and $obj -imatch "column"\)\) { Write-Output \("=" + $parent + " :: " + $obj + " [class=" + $vfp.Eval\("CLASS"\) + "]"\); Write-Output \("  Props:"\); Write-Output \($vfp.Eval\("PROPERTIES"\) -replace "^", "    "\) }; $vfp.DoCmd\("SKIP"\) } while \($true\); $vfp.Quit\(\) } catch { Write-Output "Error: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
